description: This file implements the NeedData class, which handles the 'need data' event in a GStreamer-based media playback system. It manages signaling when media data is needed for audio and video streams, interacting with the media context and client interface.

classes.name: NeedData
classes.description: Handles the 'need data' event for media streams, updating context flags and notifying the client when media data is required.

methods.name: NeedData::NeedData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the NeedData object with media context, client interface, and source element.

methods.name: NeedData::~NeedData
methods.description: Destructor logging the cleanup of the NeedData object.

methods.name: NeedData::execute
methods.description: Executes the logic to determine if media data is needed for audio or video streams and notifies the client accordingly.
